newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates steady to higher on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates steady to higher on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were steady to higher on Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, next week, mid-Mississippi River (Osceola through Cairo) no bid, offered 140 percent.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois River, bid 155 percent, unchanged, offered 172-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points.
- Two barges, week of October 6, Mississippi River, (Lacrose-Savage), no bid, offered 220 percent.
- Four barges, one each of week of October, Mid-Mississippi, bid 197-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
- Four barges, two each week of October 20 and 27, Illinois river, bid 200 percent, up five percentage points, no offer.
